label: Naive CD8 T cells
description: Cluster 0 is a naive CD8 T cell population: M69 carries the naive T program (TCF7, LEF1, CCR7, SELL, IL7R, LTB, SATB1, CD8A) at 16% share and is present in ~90% of cells with 43x enrichment, supported by top genes TCF7, LEF1, CD8A, CCR7, SATB1, KLRK1 and THEMIS. Pan-T metagenes (M61, M32) add modest T lineage support. label: Naive T cells (CD4-leaning)

Top genes TCF7, SATB1, BCL11B, LEF1, CCR7, FOXP1 and MAL support quiescent naive T cells. Several diffuse background metagenes (M0, M24, M28) carry shares without a lineage and do not change the call. No significant foreign lineage is visible, and CD4 versus CD8 is only partly resolved, with CD4 favored by M66.

label: Naive CD4 T cells (central-memory-like)

Top genes IL7R, LTB, SPOCK2, CD5, CD28, CCR4, GATA3 and CD40LG fit CD4 T cells. CCR7 and LEF1 are weak, so the naive/memory split is not sharp. Diffuse background (M0, M28, M24, M49, M95, M84) is low-specificity and not a second lineage; no clear contamination was found.
